Dwarf_Commoner
Bruno Indomicus is working to pay off his booze tab in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.
“
Word of advice? Don't open a tab here. I didn't pay for six tinsy months and suddenly it's 'work off your debt or lose a limb'. Not a bit of reason on them.
„
— Bruno Indomicus

Involvement

Act Three

Bruno Indomicus works in the kitchen of The Blushing Mermaid. He claims that his booze tab was "only a couple hundred" gold and that  Captain Grisly forced him into "damned slavery". If Grisly is killed, Bruno is relieved that he no longer needs to pay off his debt.

According to  Unpaid Debts, Bruno also owes gold to Brinks after losing a game of Baldur's Bones. Brinks demands one of Bruno's fingers as payment, but  Bosun Gannet offers to cover his debt and add it to Bruno's drink tab.
